reasoning: A fresh participant sample re-tests temporal stability findings explicitly attributed to Olvet and Hajcak (2009a) and Segalowitz et al. (2010). Olvet and Hajcak (2009b) and Pontifex et al. concern internal consistency with few trials, which supplies motivation and comparison but is not the temporal reliability finding directly retested here.
